cases.operator_intent: The referenced singer, not the drummer, must perform the lyric.
cases.generated: The drummer at frame right sings the chorus while the singer watches.
cases.override: The referenced singer at frame left sings the chorus; the drummer remains silent and plays behind her.
cases.regenerated: The drummer steps forward and performs the chorus while the singer watches.

cases.operator_intent: The subject must leave the chair and finish beside the window.
cases.generated: The subject remains seated in the center of the rehearsal room.
cases.override: The subject rises from the chair, crosses left, and finishes standing beside the window.
cases.regenerated: The subject stays seated beside the chair in the center of the room.

cases.operator_intent: Preserve identity while making the motion physically sequential.

generated.prompt: The same dancer is simultaneously kneeling and leaping across the stage.

override.prompt: The referenced dancer lowers into a kneel while keeping the same face and costume.
The dancer then rises and leaps toward frame right.

regenerated.prompt: The same dancer kneels and lands a leap at the same instant.

cases.operator_intent: Singing must stop exactly when the instrumental section begins.

generated.prompt: The vocalist sings throughout the scene.

override.prompt: The vocalist sings with visible lip sync.
The vocalist closes their mouth and listens during the instrumental section.

regenerated.prompt: The vocalist continues singing over the instrumental break.

cases.operator_intent: Keep the camera locked while the actor supplies the movement.
cases.generated: A locked-off camera rapidly orbits the actor while the actor remains still.
cases.override: The camera remains locked off; the actor walks from frame left to frame right.
cases.regenerated: The static camera circles the motionless actor in a fast arc.
